scene: Location: a small café terrace on a narrow residential alley in Seoul on a hot July afternoon around 2 pm, a faded navy-and-white striped canvas awning, an old oak table, a sunlit alley behind with low brick houses and parked scooters, the alley slightly overexposed in the hard sun. No signs, readable text, logos or license plates anywhere. Wardrobe: a pale yellow short-sleeve fine-knit top and a light-wash denim mini skirt.

cuts.1: Chest-up, her face turned about 20 degrees toward camera left, 65mm. She stands at the sunny edge of the awning; the hard sun from camera left hits only the camera-left side of her face (her right cheek and ear) and the loose wisps on that side, while the rest of her face is in shade. Her eyes are narrowed to thin slits against the glare, lips pressed together, gazing far off to the left of the frame. No hands near her face, no sweat drops. The alley behind her is bright and slightly overexposed.
cuts.4a: Chest-up, her body turned 45 degrees to camera right, 65mm. She sits at the sunny edge of the awning's shade: hard sunlight from camera left catches her cheek, temple and loose wisps on that side, the other side of her face is in shade. She holds the glass of iced coffee to her lips, mid-sip, eyes half closed. Both hands simply hold the glass.
cuts.4b: Shoulders-up from the front, 65mm, facing the camera squarely, head level, chin slightly down. She has just lowered the glass out of frame and is breathing out with relief, eyes closed, lips closed, shoulders dropping slightly. Sun from camera left on one side of her face, the other side in shade, the bright alley behind.
cuts.5a: From slightly behind and above her shoulder, 50mm. We see the back of her head, her high ponytail and only the edge of her far cheek; her face is not visible and she does not turn toward the camera. A gust of wind lifts the edge of the striped awning and sweeps her ponytail to one side. The sunlit alley ahead of her.
cuts.5b: Chest-up at eye level, 50mm. Eyes open, she is looking off toward the sunlit alley at camera left, the sun from that side on her face, the other side in shade. The breeze moves only the loose wisps at her temples; her see-through bangs stay on her forehead. Lips relaxed and closed, no smile yet.
cuts.7: Chest-up, her body turned 45 degrees to camera right, 65mm, sitting at the table in the awning's shade, sun from camera left on one side of her face; the glass of iced coffee stands at the lower left of the frame. She has just turned her eyes to the lens with a small, friendly closed-mouth smile, not a pose. Plain shaded wall in the upper left with room for an end card.

hand6: Table-height view, 65mm. The glass, beaded with condensation, has just touched down on the oak table; a young woman's right hand with light warm-toned skin and short natural nails still rests on it, the cuff of a pale yellow fine-knit sleeve at the wrist. Only the hand, wrist and sleeve cuff are visible.
hand6end: Same table-height view, 65mm. The glass stands alone on the oak table, condensation and one wet ring under it, the ice slightly turned. No hand.
